summary: Cut, trim and split clips on the timeline: set a clip's source in/out range on any editor project, preserving the rest of the timeline. Headless adapter operation; frame accuracy depends on the adapter's declared cut mode.

inputs.name: project
inputs.constraints: native editor project artifact (adapter-wrapped); or a probed media asset to start a project

inputs.name: sourceMedia
inputs.constraints: content-addressed, probe metadata attached (durationSeconds, fps, width, height)

outputs.name: updatedProject
outputs.constraints: new immutable project revision; previous artifacts untouched

parameters.name: clipIndex
parameters.description: Flat index into the clips of all tracks in canonical order (video tracks bottom-up, then audio).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: New source-in point within the clip's source range; omit to keep the current in point.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: New source-out point within the clip's source range; omit to cut to the end of available source.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: reencode = frame-accurate; stream-copy = keyframe-aligned lossless (adapter support and semantics declared per mapping).

qualityDimensions.description: Closeness of the realized cut boundaries to the requested ones.
Decodability and A/V sync of the resulting stream (stream-copy snapping degrades this near non-keyframe boundaries).
Same inputs produce byte-identical project revisions.

costModel.notes: Local CLI execution. stream-copy is near-zero compute; reencode scales with duration and resolution.

providerMappings.notes: melt CLI; in/out points on playlist entries; frame-grid quantization. Live conformance skipped in Phase 1 sandbox (melt binary absent).
ffmpeg CLI; reencode cuts frame-accurate (input-side -ss), stream-copy cuts keyframe-aligned (declared). Live conformance scenario basic-cut run against ffmpeg 6/7 in the Phase 1 sandbox.
kdenlive project XML authored headlessly; rendered via melt. Live conformance skipped (kdenlive_render/melt absent).
Project JSON authoring only. Headless export is a documented coverage gap (gap.losslesscut-headless-cut, kind editor-coverage-gap); no GUI workaround per lock P5.

notes: Launch descriptor (draft per lock §7). Adapter mappings point at the six-editor launch set; the registry index is @gen/media-capabilities' (no second index, lock §8.1).
